mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading highlights the 27° central angle between the radii. Right image: The shading selects the triangular subarea with an apex on the top of the rectangle.
Rationales: The feature highlights the angle between two rays in the left image and selects a geometric area in the right image. The lavender wedge at the right-hand junction of the two radii. The gray triangle against the baseline of the partitioned rectangle.
